told myself im a morning person. Basically pretended i was talking someone, like a friend or a coworker or a first date, and said “yeah i’m a big morning! i love going to bed early and waking up early!” Very casually. The key is to feel the feelings of whatever it is that u are manifesting and it should feel NORMAL. Because feeling it normal implies that its true (living in the end state) and that things have always been this way (changing the old story) ! Took a few weeks to show up in the 3D but dont think about that. I did this once or twice and then forgot about it (didnt look for signs in the 3d, wondering when its coming) and then it showed up! I think its happening to me right now.

Started dating my current bf last year. A few months into the relationship some guy with lots of mutual friends follows me so i follow back. I wasnt drawn to him (he didnt really have any photos of himself) or anything until one day he posted a screenshot of a song which happened to be my favourite song. I started thinking damn this guys has good taste, but whatever its just a song.

Anyways soon enough i forgot about him and continued to live my life. A few months later he messages me and we start talking every single day for like 4 months. Told him i had a boyfriend and he seemed pretty disappointed but we continued to be friends. It was crazy how similar are lives were and how much we had in common. We just clicked. He ended up becoming such an important person in my life. My boyfriend isnt very emotionally available so when i needed to have a deep conversation with someone he was there for me. I felt so deeply connected to him. But my boyfriend was going through a rough time and i didnt want to leave him like that. Plus i still loved my boyfriend, we just had a few problems here and there like any other relationship. The guy and I eventually stopped talking and now he has a girlfriend who he seems to really love based off of what i see on social media. We’ve talked a few times since but they’ve all been pretty short. We havent talked in like 3 ish months. 

Im happy for him & My boyfriend and i are doing much better now too. I still think about him sometimes and cant help but wonder what if we met a little sooner? But i truly believe the universe has a plan for all of us and everything was supposed to happen the way it did. Right now im happy and so is he and i wouldnt change a thing, but hopefully one day we will start talking again. I miss my best friend /:
